scope: Approved 104 HTX futures assets. N12 market route prequalification using retained N05 exact identity/market catalog and historical original 240-minute windows. This is not current N12 recent-trade coverage, full all104 reporting, or live cross-venue agreement.

market_classification.HTX: FUTURES approved for all104; spot to be verified per exact current public market and fresh raw trade rows

priority.ideal: Exact-asset fresh spot and futures trades on HTX and independent exchanges with comparable same-clock market windows; broadly matching direction and strength
priority.fallback: Verified available market/venue facts only, marked partial; missing market is unknown rather than zero
priority.conflict: Show separate facts; suppress common directional conclusion
priority.batch: Use original retained responses and existing routes first. Read current source ledger and admission before one targeted live missing-fact batch. Do not raise existing per-role/caller caps or duplicate HTX N12 futures HTTP.

limits: External structural route is a candidate, not a current open market, fresh raw trade batch, complete 240-minute window or report use.

HTX spot individual exact current listings were not counted from the retained external N05 map; zero in that proof field means unmeasured, not unavailable.
N12 recent five-minute bounded samples and N05 four-hour complete windows retain separate clocks and cannot be summed as a shared interval.
No new provider HTTP, D1 write or Telegram send was used to build this offline matrix.
